dimensions.description: Plan maps mission success criteria to concrete tasks with explicit outputs.
high_score_requirements: Every success criterion has one or more task ids linked in rationale or plan structure.
No major objective area is unowned.

dimensions.description: Unknowns are handled through explicit discovery/extraction tasks before implementation.
high_score_requirements: Research tasks are early in the plan.
Research outputs are structured artifacts used by downstream tasks.

dimensions.description: Work is decomposed into atomic, explicit, and tractable batches.
high_score_requirements: Task prompts define scope and exclusions.
Batch sizes are reasonable for risk and complexity.

dimensions.description: Deterministic verification is present after each major modification phase.
high_score_requirements: Modification batches are followed by deterministic command validation or deterministic loop gates.

dimensions.description: Ordering and parallelism choices are safe and dependency-aware.
Plan includes canary review, failure handling, and resumable artifacts.
high_score_requirements: At least one canary/review checkpoint exists before broad rollout.
Plan structure supports resume and iterative repair.

dimensions.description: Limits are configured to bound runtime and failure blast radius.
high_score_requirements: Plan sets practical values for runtime/task/failure caps.
Loop iteration caps are scoped appropriately.

hard_fail_checks.description: Plan is not valid Agentflow schema or has structurally invalid nodes.
Mission includes unresolved unknowns but plan has no explicit research/extraction tasks.
Plan has modification tasks without deterministic validation command/gate coverage.
Limits are absent or effectively unbounded for the mission context.
Parallel execution is proposed despite clear dependency ordering requirements.
